_note: Hand-filled where the game files do not say where a Slasher lore item is. Keyed by EditorID. location = text shown on the page; mapImage / locationImage = full /wp-content/uploads/... paths if you did not use the default names (guide-images/collectables/Slasher-Lore/<item-name-slug>-map.avif and -location.avif); image = the row picture (notes: <slug>-note.avif, holotapes: holotape.avif). noFixedPlace: true = the item has no set spot in the world (mask order, random grave, enemy drop, quest delivery); the page then shows only the text, no map/location picture boxes.

SDOW_MQ01_Bodies_Note01.location: Pops up when you pick up your 1st Pint-Sized Slasher Mask, wherever that mask is, so the spot depends on the order you collect them. For example: Ashley's 1st mask was on the car at Dino Peaks Mini Golf.

SDOW_MQ01_Bodies_Note02.location: Pops up when you pick up your 3rd Pint-Sized Slasher Mask, wherever that mask is, so the spot depends on the order you collect them. For example: Ashley's 3rd mask was in the shack at Dino Peaks Mini Golf.

SDOW_MQ01_Bodies_Note03.location: Pops up when you pick up your 5th Pint-Sized Slasher Mask, wherever that mask is, so the spot depends on the order you collect them. For example: Ashley's 5th mask was at the ticket booth at Starlight Drive-in.

SDOW_MQ01_Bodies_Note04.location: Pops up when you pick up your 7th Pint-Sized Slasher Mask, wherever that mask is, so the spot depends on the order you collect them. For example: Ashley's 7th mask was at World of Corn.

SDOW_MQ01_Bodies_Note05.location: Pops up when you pick up your 10th Pint-Sized Slasher Mask, wherever that mask is, so the spot depends on the order you collect them. For example: Ashley's 10th mask was on the deck chair at Tycoon Lake.

SDOW_MQ01_Bodies_FinalMessage.location: In the bloody mess at the dog kennel. Read "A page torn from a children's book", investigate the area it describes, then search the dog kennel the quest marks.

SDOW_MQ01_BroadcastRecording.location: Given to you by The Slasher: Masked Truth after the "Breaking News" broadcast, so there's nothing to go and find. It turns up in your Pip-Boy's holotapes.

SDOW_MQ02_Graves_Holotape.location: On the Smiling Clown at Tyler County Fairgrounds, after reading "Our Mission - Part IV" ("Seek your fortune").

SDOW_MQ02_Graves_Journal01.location: Dug up from a Disturbed Grave. Read a Pint-Sized Phantoms' Map (a reward from activities and events) and dig at the grave it marks; each grave gives you the next page. The grave is picked at random, so the spot changes (the Pint-Sized Phantoms Grave Sites guide shows them all). For example: Ashley's Part I came from the grave at Lady Janet's Soft Serve.

SDOW_MQ04_Infestations_Note01.location: In whichever of the two trunks you open first: the steamer trunk in Gauley Mine or the trunk in RobCo Research Center. The pictures show Ashley's, who did Gauley Mine first.

SDOW_MQ04_Infestations_Note02.location: In whichever of the two trunks you open second: the steamer trunk in Gauley Mine or the trunk in RobCo Research Center. The pictures show Ashley's, who did RobCo Research Center second.

SDOW_MQ04_Infestations_Note03.location: Not placed anywhere in the world and not in either trunk: the quest The Slasher: Out of the Shadows hands it out. Exactly when isn't confirmed yet.

SDOW_MQ04_Infestations_Holotape.location: On the Pint-Sized Phantom Tinkerer in Organ Cave. Defeat him, then search him.

SDOW_MQ05_BroadcastRecording.location: Given to you by The Slasher: Blood Will Have Blood after the "A Warning" broadcast, so there's nothing to go and find. It turns up in your Pip-Boy's holotapes.

SDOW_Note_Initiation01.location: Dropped by Pint-Sized Phantoms once you've finished The Slasher: Masked Truth, so there's no set spot. For example: Ashley got this one from a Phantom inside RobCo Research Center.
